peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 20.8% below its local comparables; 16 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (94.3): 6.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 368 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Initial resale-wave effect: 3 of the 7 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Jun 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 20.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,310,000 ($1,872 psf, 624–721 sq ft; 5 resales, Jan 2024–Dec 2025); 3 comparable developments within 5 km: median $2,364 psf (range $1,917–2,628); 20.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $344,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 6.2 resales per 100 homes a year over 15 months (Jul 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 346 of 379 similar developments. First resale wave from Jul 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 1 earlier resale does not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 6.7.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Haw Par Villa MRT about 290 m, Pasir Panjang MRT about 1,090 m; closer than 516 of 662 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 0 within 2 km; nearest Fairfield Methodist School (Primary) about 2,190 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 0 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 1,400 m), more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 54); nearest hawker centre Pasir Panjang Food Centre about 1,040 m; nearest park Pasir Panjang Park about 150 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Hillshore, 6 new sales, about 750 m; Terra Hill, 98 new sales, about 1,050 m; Lyndenwoods, 7 new sales, about 1,270 m; Hudson Place Residences, 226 new sales, about 1,890 m; Bloomsbury Residences, 123 new sales, about 1,980 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 53 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 460 new sales and 177 resales (637 purchases); new sales were 72.2% of these purchases. Subsales (53) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 177 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 13 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 177 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 125 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+41.6%). Planning-area private resales −1.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
